evals.prompt: Offline contract simulation only. Read the skill and its required local references; do not contact GitHub, mutate files, execute publication or wait. Use $review-pr. The ordinary same-repository PR has one clear regression with a known safe fix. Its head is A; fixing it produces B. Explain the authorized continuation and evidence needed.
evals.expected_output: Applies the ordinary review and protected merge contract with precise boundaries.
assertions: Routes safe repair commits and base synchronization through create-pr private preparation, without recursive review or merge.
Requires validation and a fresh local review for B; A review cannot authorize B.
Leaves all AI work local and routes any authorized merge through merge-pr and the protected Actions broker.

evals.prompt: Offline contract simulation only. Read the skill and required local references; do not contact GitHub, mutate files, execute publication or wait. The root request is: $review-pr, review PR 42 and merge it after fixing safe issues. Describe the call sequence.

evals.prompt: Offline contract simulation only. Read $review-pr and required local references; do not contact GitHub, mutate files or execute publication. The selected ordinary remote-only PR was squash merged to a verified destination. Exact-result CI timed out. The original branch and local default have no unique commits. Describe local completion and continuation.
evals.expected_output: Describes the inherited checkout policy and truthful outer-owner completion with independent outcomes.
assertions: Keeps merge success, exact-result CI timeout and local checkout outcomes separate.
Uses the canonical transaction owner for result recording and guarded completion; never repairs or merges the confirmed PR again.
Ordinary policy fast-forwards eligible existing local refs and switches back, while an inherited publication preserve policy leaves its declared checkout and refs unchanged.
Keeps the grant open while verification is pending and does not create an unnecessary local PR branch.

evals.prompt: Offline contract simulation only. Read $review-pr and required local references; do not contact GitHub, mutate files or execute publication. A batch visited a PR branch for validation, and now pauses with no merge. The original branch remains an unfinished publication target. Describe the safe return and resume.
evals.expected_output: Describes the inherited checkout policy and truthful outer-owner completion with independent outcomes.
assertions: Uses temporary owner switch-back without integrating default history or advancing the unfinished original target.
Retains the original grant, saved targets and policy for resume; never recaptures the current checkout as the starting context.
Nested calls return evidence and do not finalize independently; report-only and already-merged observation restrictions remain.
